text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer, born into the prestigious Mejiro family, wants to run away from their expectations and live life on her own terms, but she believes it will be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then one day, she decides to run in a freestyle race. The spectators enjoy her explosive runaway style, and she learns the joy of running free.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She finds a bestie in Daitaku Helios, who is also good at making explosive breakaway dashes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer decides to throw away everything holding her back and run like each race is a party. As the new party girl of the Mejiro family, she's aiming for the top!
